colour.DESCRIPTION: A #RRGGBB decoration. Never the sole carrier of information.

enabled.DESCRIPTION: Whether the cue runs at all. A disabled cue is skipped, not deleted.

kind.DESCRIPTION: What kind of cue this is, derived from the element rather than stored: a Group is a group and a Media is media. Deriving it is what stops a client turning one kind into another by writing a word, and what lets the grammar refuse a file attribute on a cue that plays nothing.

name.DESCRIPTION: The cue's name, as the operator reads it.

number.DESCRIPTION: The decimal cue number. A string, because 12.5.1 is one; mutable, renumbered during tech, and never an identity.

parent.DESCRIPTION: The identifier of the containing list or group.

postWait.DESCRIPTION: How long after completion before this cue reports done to its parent. A group is complete once every member is, its members' own post-waits included; the group's post-wait then runs on top of that.

preWait.DESCRIPTION: How long after entry before this cue starts. A group has one of its own, and it runs before its members begin their own pre-waits, so raising it defers the whole group.
